Name: UI Helper
Author: ProfeJavix
Description:
This mod doesn't add anything by itself, so you'll only need to install it if another mod uses it as dependency.

For SMAPI modders [url=https://github.com/ProfeJavix/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/UIHelper]HERE[/url] you can find the source and the instructions to use UI Helper in your mod. If you have any issue, please let me know. I'll be improving some behaviours and the feedback would be great :).

Manifest.Name: UIHelper
Manifest.Description: Dependencia para ayudar a modders de SMAPI a dibujar UI.
